messages.author: Cheesar
messages.text: during this attack the only air units i had were about 20 helicopters and nothing at all happened

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@616524068987863060> not a bug, that's how air attacks work: helicopters (and fighters/bombers) can only be met by the defender's air units. if they have no air units there's nothing to fight, so nothing happens and nothing dies. to hit ground troops you have to attack with the ground domain (soldiers/tanks/artillery). we'll make the attack screen say this more clearly, and if you want helicopters to hit ground units post it in #suggestions and it goes on the next ballot

messages.author: Cheesar
messages.text:
ah i see
i was confused because on the attack tab it clearly says that helicopters attack ground units

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@616524068987863060> done, helicopters can hit ground troops now. in the attack screen they show up under Ground Invasion (send them with your soldiers/tanks/artillery) and they still work in the Air War too. they do extra damage to soldiers and tanks, but soldiers counter them so don't send them alone. it's live, try it and tell me how it feels
